title: auth.json (envelope)
description: The addresses a delivered app signs its visitors in at. Present only when the app has a way in: either an issuer (PKCE) or a session-server door (password and/or providers through the app's own origin). Hand-written; see envelope.md.

provider.description: oauth2-pkce for an external issuer. For the app door a publisher writes password (the door takes a password) or platform (provider buttons only); a reader treats any other value as the app door.

scopes.description: The scopes to ask the issuer for. A publisher appends offline_access when the declaration lacks it, so a refresh token (and the door token) exists.

methods.description: The identity's declared methods, copied as they are. Informative; a runner draws the wall from loginUrl and providers.

apiBase.description: The app's own API base (where its records are served). Optional; when absent a reader derives it from the first door address that ends in its route, with the route removed (session-protocol.md section 2).
